professional_summary.content: Sabrina (chronological age: 2 years, 10 months) was assessed using multiple standardized pediatric assessment tools to evaluate developmental functioning across cognitive, social-emotional, motor, language, and sensory domains. The comprehensive evaluation revealed both areas of strength, such as emerging developmental skills and social engagement, and areas requiring targeted intervention support, including fine motor coordination, attention and focus, and communication skills. Sabrina's limited interest in sensory exploration and withdrawal from sensory experiences may impact her functional performance and daily activities. Based on the assessment findings, occupational therapy services are recommended to address these areas of need. A collaborative, family-centered approach involving speech and behavioral therapy will be beneficial in promoting her development. With appropriate intervention, Sabrina is expected to benefit significantly from services, enhancing her long-term prognosis. Family involvement and education are vital components to ensure consistent progress. Regular monitoring and reassessment will be important to track developmental milestones and adaptations to the individualized intervention plan.
